item.title: STORM PREPAREDNESS WEEK
item.description: Next week is Severe Weather Preparedness Week in Kansas and emergency management agencies all across the state are encouraging all public partners, businesses, schools, and community organizations to take part in the activities planned for the week. One of the biggest events is the statewide tornado drill that will be held Wednesday at 10:00 in the morning. item.title: COLYER IN GARNETT THURSDAY
item.description: The Anderson County Republicans will host former Kansas Governor and 2026 candidate for the same office, Jeff Colyer at the party’s monthly meeting tomorrow. item.description: Norma Jean Sobba, 90, passed away peacefully on Sunday, February 22, 2026. item.description: Roger A. Ward was born September 18, 1940, as a member of the Munsee Tribe in Kansas, and was a lifelong resident of Ottawa until his death on February 20, 2026. item.title: Louise J. McClendon
item.description: Louise Julie Doehring McClendon passed away February 22, 2026, at the age of 90, in Lawrence, Kansas, her home for nearly 60 years. item.title: Ralph “Jerry” Silver
item.description: Melvern – Ralph “Jerry” Silver, 91, passed away on Wednesday, February 25, 2026, at Brookside Retirement Community in Overbrook, Kansas. He was born on June 4, 1934, in Burlingame, Kansas, the son of Ralph and Lucille (Hogle) Silver. Jerry, as he was known to all, grew up in Burlingame and had lived in Colombia and Brazil as a Missionary and then Florida before moving to Lyndon for 11 years.
